'''María del Pilar Díaz''' is an Argentine statistician. She is a professor of statistics in the Faculty of Economics at the [[National University of Córdoba]] (UNC).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.graduados.eco.unc.edu.ar/es/27-institucional/docentes/97-dra-maria-del-pilar-diaz|title=Dra. María del Pilar Díaz|website=www.graduados.eco.unc.edu.ar|access-date=2019-08-06}}</ref> Pilar Díaz was an instructor in the Department of Statistics and Biostatistics in the School of Nutrition in the {{Interlanguage link|Facultad de Ciencias Médicas (Universidad Nacional de Córdoba)|lt=Faculty of Medical Sciences|es||WD=}} at UNC in 1983.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=PDI - Resultado de Búsqueda |url=https://investigadores.anid.cl/es/public_search/researcher?id=30566 |access-date=2022-08-02 |website=investigadores.anid.cl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Clarín.com |date=2022-04-11 |title=Quiénes son los 12 médicos e investigadores argentinos de mayor impacto mundial |url=https://www.clarin.com/brandstudio/12-medicos-investigadores-argentinos-mayor-impacto-mundial_0_DlTvNVz73O.html |access-date=2022-08-02 |website=Clarín |language=es}}</ref>

Pilar Díaz completed a bachelor's degree in mathematics at UNC. She earned a master's degree (in 1992) and doctorate in statistics (in 1996) at the [[University of São Paulo]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
